@ravenbait@mastodon.scot It's ultimately a pretty simple fix, actually.

There's a #Linux programme called #Lutris that uses #WINE (ie, Wine Is Not an Emulator) to run Windows games on Linux, and someone at Lutris made a custom installer for #Scrivener. It's very nearly "click this button and we'll do it for you." I sent Lutris $50 after that.

There's a YouTube video by a guy who goes by the name The Linux Author: 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i8IJ4fO1n64

#FOSS #FLOSS #OpenSource
